note: Frontier release radar: expected upcoming models + market-implied odds, adversarially verified against real markets/announcements.

items.basis: Rumored Jul 17 GA is now tomorrow, but still no model card, pricing or API listing; Polymarket prices the next Gemini Pro at only ~51% by Jul 30 (78% for a Gemini reasoning flagship by Jul 31).
Polymarket slid to ~68% by Dec 31, ~40% by Sep 30, ~2% by Jul 31 (down from ~90%/75%); OpenAI's public roadmap still runs through GPT-5.x, pushing conviction to late 2026.
Anthropic's ~6-week Opus cadence (4.6 Feb, 4.7 Apr, 4.8 May) points to a next Opus; unannounced, no dated market.
xAI (now SpaceXAI) shipped Grok 4.5 on Jul 8; a Grok 5 foundation is floated but undated.
V4-Pro/Flash shipped Apr 24 as previews; a stable GA is pending, with a reported Jul 24 developer deadline.
